newsitem.title: UK: Argentina to up global bond to $1.0 bln - traders.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to up global bond to $1.0 bln - traders.

text.p: Argentina is likely to increase to $1.0 billion its $750 million 10-year global bond launched on Tuesday, syndicate sources close to the deal said on Wednesday.
The bond will be priced later to yield between 445 and 450 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes and the increase is expected to be announced at the same time.
Argentina is rated B1 by Moody's Investors Service and BB- by Standard & Poor's Corp.
Joint lead managers for the transaction are Goldman Sachs and Salomon Brothers.
